scope: Incomplete discovery seed for CORE-CLOSE-001; not an exhaustive native declaration inventory
unreviewed_scope: A: Complete Mat/UMat/SparseMat lifecycle, allocation, strides, reshape, external views, all public typed access specifications and fixed helpers; root value-type equivalence
B: All arithmetic depth/channel/N-D/mask/output modes; bitwise, LUT, reductions, channel routing, borders, sorting, concatenation and destination mode matrices
C: invert/solve decomposition flags, least squares, eigen/eigenNonSymmetric, SVD/backSubst/solveZ, PCA/LDA, covariance modes, polynomial solvers and optim.hpp solver callbacks
D: Full DFT/DCT scaling/nonzeroRows/row-wise/CCS modes, CCS conversion and destination alias proof
E: RNG/RNG_MT19937/distribution/shuffle modes, kmeans, covariance, PSNR, checkRange/patchNaNs and special-value tests
F: All 32 sparse typed layouts, stored traversal invalidation, conversion tables, native arithmetic surface and extrema lifetime/error tests
G: Complete FileStorage/FileNode methods, formats/encoding/raw persistence, typed values, sequence/map error and lifetime tests
H: CPU reporting, error redirection/break-on-error, global state, parallel execution, logging, filesystem and command-line utilities
I: Vec/Matx/Complex/Point/Rect/Size/RotatedRect/Range/TermCriteria, Algorithm/Ptr, affine and quaternion overload semantics, softfloat and new OpenCV 5 types
J: ocl.hpp/cuda.hpp/OpenGL/DirectX/VA interfaces, bufferpool/allocator support, async ownership, accelerator exclusions and CPU fallback qualification
Discovery closure: inspect additional public Core headers and assign every discovered in-scope capability; representative-name extraction is not exhaustive parsing

capabilities.variants: Native axis permutation; no Ada N-D transpose equivalent established. Ordinary Transpose is a separate 2-D operation.
capabilities.ownership: Proposed result should be Ada-owned Mat; continuity, permutation and alias rules need implementation review.
concerns: No 4.1 native entry; compatibility algorithm not proven
capabilities.complexity: Medium if gated; large if backported
capabilities.maintenance: Version branch and permutation safety tests
qualification_gaps: Native implementation and safe 4.1 disposition not reviewed

mode_matrix.name: N-D permutation
mode_matrix.evidence: Only 2-D Transpose in current public Core spec

capabilities.variants: Axis-selected N-D flip; existing Flip_Kind only covers 2-D axes.
capabilities.ownership: Prefer independent Mat result; require strided and in-place native investigation.
concerns: 4.1 and 4.6 need explicit exclusion or independently qualified fallback
qualification_gaps: Depth/channel/strided behavior unreviewed

capabilities.variants: 4.10 InputArray shape; 5.0 additionally MatShape overload. Repeat is not general broadcasting.
capabilities.ownership: Output ownership, expansion sizes and integer multiplication bounds need proof.
concerns: Do not conflate explicit broadcast with implicit arithmetic broadcasting
No proven historical fallback
qualification_gaps: Broadcast implementation, size overflow and aliasing not reviewed

capabilities.variants: Ada unary/masked L1/L2/Infinity. Pairwise norms, relative flag, squared L2 and Hamming/Hamming2 absent from this API, although batch distances support some of them. Exact depth/channel/N-D set needs source_for_norm review.
capabilities.ownership: Scalar result; reads inputs. Pairwise must not be emulated by saturating integer Abs_Diff followed by unary Norm.
concerns: Relative zero denominator and Hamming mask semantics require native source review
capabilities.downstream: Descriptor matching and numeric error measurement
capabilities.maintenance: Low with explicit strong options and mode tests
qualification_gaps: Cross-version mode/depth/channel/NaN/Inf and ABI tests not inventoried

mode_matrix.name: Unary and masked L1/L2/Infinity
mode_matrix.evidence: Exact declarations, bodies, imports and two native shim definitions recorded

mode_matrix.name: Pairwise/relative/squared/Hamming
mode_matrix.evidence: Norm_Kind is L1/L2/Infinity; both public profiles are unary with optional mask

capabilities.variants: Nonempty UInt8/Float32 C1 2-D row vectors. L1/L2/L2 squared; UInt8 also Hamming/Hamming2. Top-K only. Masks/update/crosscheck/all-pairs not exposed. Float32 distances except Int32 Hamming; Int32 indices.
capabilities.ownership: Independent distance and index Mats. Inputs and non-contiguous Regions accepted read-only. Tie ordering native-defined.
concerns: All-pairs and masks may matter more than convenience overloads
capabilities.maintenance: Low-medium; keep distinct from general norm API
qualification_gaps: Every registered test and compatibility edge not mapped

capabilities.variants: Bound functions/procedures require same-type 2-D Mat/Mat or UMat/UMat. Scalar arithmetic modes are not present in these public profiles; mask and dtype choices also need separate mode review.
capabilities.ownership: Functions allocate independent results; destination forms reuse/rebind storage. Arbitrary partial overlap is unsupported; per-operation contract applies.
concerns: Reverse subtract/divide and 1..4 scalar channels need deliberate API design
Native saturation and Int32 overflow must be preserved
capabilities.maintenance: Low if shared validated scalar policy; avoid overload explosion
qualification_gaps: All arithmetic mode/depth/channel qualification incomplete

capabilities.variants: Mat/Mat and UMat/UMat comparisons with strong Comparison_Kind; scalar comparison is absent. Scalar In_Range is already a different bound capability.
capabilities.ownership: UInt8 mask output; independent result and reusable destinations exist. Destination overlap policy requires full review.
concerns: Scalar rounding/out-of-range and NaN behavior need native tests
C ABI full comparison mapping still to inventory
qualification_gaps: C ABI mapping and depth/channel mode audit incomplete

capabilities.variants: Only unmasked scalar UMat Set_To. Native accepts optional mask. Representative mat.hpp extraction includes Mat methods too; UMat class scope must be checked manually.
capabilities.ownership: Mutates shared storage; no binding-level host mapping should be introduced.
concerns: UMat mask must be same installation/backend-compatible
CPU fallback is not GPU execution guarantee
qualification_gaps: Native class scope and complete masked mode safety review

capabilities.variants: Ada Copy_To returns newly allocated UMat. No caller-owned or masked UMat destination overload; Mat has both. Native mat.hpp representatives need UMat scope review.
capabilities.ownership: Current result is independent. Future destination must preserve native reuse/rebind and retained alias semantics, not assignment from a temporary.
concerns: Masked fresh output initialization versus reused unselected values
Exact and partial overlap policies
capabilities.maintenance: Low if destination rules match Mat
qualification_gaps: All version/mask/ROI/rebind/empty cases not inventoried

capabilities.variants: Current Reshape overloads return Mat only; UMat reshape unsupported by published ownership guide. Native overload parity and 5.0 MatShape changes not yet reviewed.
capabilities.ownership: Zero-copy shared header; continuity and dimensionality restrictions essential.
concerns: Need exact UMat declaration scope and all-version reshape implementation evidence
qualification_gaps: N-D overload availability and shape contracts unresolved

capabilities.variants: Mat Float32/Float64 2-D, full C2 complex and packed C1 CCS, inverse real and row-wise functions exist. DCT C1 with even transformed lengths except identity. No UMat or in-place/destination procedures.
capabilities.ownership: Independent Mat outputs, non-contiguous input Regions accepted. Transform buffer arithmetic safety limits documented in public spec; complete per-mode checks not reviewed here.
concerns: nonzeroRows and selectable scaling modes not fully mapped
CCS access/conversion is separate from arithmetic Divide
qualification_gaps: Full native transform and tests mode matrix unfinished

capabilities.variants: Full complex C2, packed C1 and row-wise packed spectrum multiplication; direct versus conjugated second operand. Float32/Float64 Mat only. No reusable/in-place/UMat form.
capabilities.ownership: Independent output; sources unchanged. CCS layout is not ordinary elementwise multiplication.
concerns: Complex row flag and destination alias semantics need full audit
qualification_gaps: Complete native modes, dimensions and tests review pending

capabilities.variants: 5.0 Core declares packed or complex division with DFT_ROWS and conjB. Earlier Imgproc-local/internal helpers are not portable Core API.
capabilities.ownership: Prefer independent result initially. Zero-denominator, Hermitian and packed edge behavior need numerical investigation.
concerns: Mat Divide is real elementwise division, not spectrum division
No proven portable CCS division fallback
capabilities.maintenance: High if historical compatibility algorithm added
qualification_gaps: 5.0 implementation and historical fallback unqualified

capabilities.variants: 5.0 per-element finite mask; scalar Float16 Is_Finite and Mat Check_Range do not provide the same capability.
capabilities.ownership: Owned mask output; exact output channel/depth/shape behavior requires implementation review.
concerns: Ada non-finite validity checks and callback borrowed access must not leak Constraint_Error
Cannot assume compare(X,X) detects infinities
capabilities.maintenance: Low gated; medium for bitwise historical fallback
qualification_gaps: Native implementation and historical IEEE fallback not proven

capabilities.variants: Portable native version and build description queries; no public Ada equivalents found in public spec search.

concerns: Build string content is installation-dependent, not a stable parseable schema
capabilities.downstream: All module diagnostics and support reports
qualification_gaps: Full public package declaration review still required to close negative finding

capabilities.variants: Portable entry points, backend-dependent thread behavior. No public Ada equivalents found.
capabilities.ownership: Process-global native state; do not promise thread-local isolation or safe concurrent mutation.
concerns: Native reset/default/disable semantics and parallel-region restrictions need explicit design
qualification_gaps: Native backend semantics and test-state restoration review incomplete

capabilities.variants: Global native optimization switch/query; no public Ada equivalent found.
capabilities.ownership: Global state, configure outside concurrent active OpenCV calls; restore state in tests.
concerns: Not a guarantee of deterministic numeric bits or a universal backend-disable switch
qualification_gaps: Global-state native implementation safety review pending

capabilities.variants: Portable native wall-clock tick/frequency pair; Ada.Real_Time may be a deliberate alternative but is not an existing Core binding.
capabilities.ownership: Value results; preserve signed 64-bit tick width and double frequency.
concerns: Do not substitute getCPUTickCount; epoch and cross-machine comparability not guaranteed
qualification_gaps: Timer semantics and independent Ada equivalent disposition pending

capabilities.variants: Current Read_Only/Write_Only disk API and memory helpers; append/Base64 flags absent. Native APPEND and BASE64 enum constants are present in all four headers; representative open signature alone does not prove flags.
capabilities.ownership: Limited File_Storage owns native lifetime; retain existing safe navigation and copied read results.
concerns: Append is incompatible with native MEMORY mode
Need loss/failure and duplicate-key policies; no silent flag pass-through
qualification_gaps: Pin enum constant evidence and complete implementation/C ABI mappings

capabilities.variants: Headers document .gz. Public Ada spec explicitly excludes gzip; actual extension validation and build feature guards require review. 5.0 documents compression-level suffixes too.
capabilities.ownership: Disk ownership follows File_Storage; compressed stream error/close behavior matters.
concerns: Zlib availability is a native build feature, not universal portable execution
No claim current Open already supports gzip
qualification_gaps: Exact zlib feature guards and current Ada validation not mapped

capabilities.variants: Public Ada uses storage-scoped navigation, Sequence_Length/indexed reads and Map_Length/Map_Key, not exposed FileNode iterators.
capabilities.ownership: Native iterator/node borrows FileStorage; exposing it would add lifetime coupling.
concerns: Semantic iteration capability still needs complete mapping; exclusion applies to escaping native iterator abstraction, not sequence/map iteration
capabilities.exclusion_reason: Retain limited owning File_Storage and copied values; raw FileNode/iterator lifetime protocol adds risk with little consumer value. This is a proposed audit exclusion for review, not a new API promise.
qualification_gaps: Advanced node capabilities and safe callback alternative not fully reviewed

capabilities.variants: The sparse normalization family exists, but MINMAX is expressly prohibited by native docs because shifting implicit zero changes sparsity. Not a native-supported missing mode.
capabilities.ownership: Keep implicit zero semantics; caller may explicitly densify then normalize.
concerns: Availability refers to normalize family, not support for MINMAX
capabilities.exclusion_reason: Native SparseMat normalization excludes range shift of implicit zeros. Do not invent a silently densifying sparse operation.
capabilities.downstream: Explicit dense conversion is the coherent alternative
qualification_gaps: Pin explanatory native comment and sparse-specific implementation guard as structured evidence

Do not casually reimplement for 4.1
